description: Makes a link that opens Tribute Paper with every design already showing the person's name, dates of birth and passing, and the service date, time, venue and town, the same as the site's "Save your details once and every design shows them". With a design slug it opens that design ready to edit (designing is free; a free sign-in is asked for first). Offer it when the family is ready to make a program or card, using only details they have shared. The details ride in the link's #fragment, so they stay in the family's browser and are not sent to Tribute Paper's server. Give at least one detail.

born.description: Date of birth: a year (1938) or a full date (1938-03-03).

design.description: Optional: a design to open straight away (from search_designs).

died.description: Date of passing: a year (2026) or a full date (2026-11-02).

name.description: Their full name as it should appear, e.g. Margaret Ellis.

size.description: Optional, with a design: story (phone card), card (5 × 7 print), square, program (folded booklet, US Letter) or oos (order of service, A4).

town.description: The town or city, e.g. Boston.

venue.description: Where the service is, e.g. St Mary's Church.

name: start_design_link
title: Make a start link
